items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: I think I was reading something about the composer Arvo Part.

ctx.x: Was “Waltz for the Proud Tired Warriors” one of those?

That was written at McDowell. That was part of “Heaven and Hell.” That was more hard to describe. There was a sequence of chords in the 4-bar or 6-bar modules that kept changing. I think I was reading something about the composer Arvo Part. And he was taking these phrases and going up a third, down a major third. Up a minor third, down a major third, up a minor – so I just said hey, I could take this little cell that I wrote and do it with that but have an alto sax solo over the whole thing. So that was that part.
And the alto sax player, how do I put this – have a chart? Did he know?
